speakerRef.description: raw label (e.g. spk:0) or resolved personId

speakerLabel.description: human-readable speaker name, when the source already knows one (e.g. a WhatsApp archiver's real pushName/savedName); speakerRef stays the stable id

occurredAt.description: real wall-clock ISO datetime the turn occurred, when the source has one (e.g. a WhatsApp message's real ts); tStart/tEnd stay relative-offset seconds
